entries.title: Task titles no longer end in the middle of a word
entries.body: A task's title could be saved cut off at its last letter that fit, so the board and cards showed titles such as "…cards on a vi". Your first mate and crewmates are now asked to say a long title shorter before the task is saved, and a title the app writes itself ends on a whole word.
entries.noPicture: A whole title looks like any other title; the fix changes which words a new task is saved with, not how a view draws them.
